article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms Home Show feature (posted about three days before the 2010-11-26 capture, so no absolute date) spotlighting player Firehawk894's Small Wilds House, decorated with a large Serpent Dragon Slide. The player describes the build time and coin cost and says he earned coins through Power Hour between work sessions.

article_summaries.title: Programa Hogareño: Firehawk894
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms 'Home Showcase' feature (Programa Hogareño) on a player's Small Wilds House decorated with a large serpent-dragon slide. The post gives the build cost and time (about 4 days and about 85,000 coins) and says the coins came partly through Power Hour. The page is dated only as 'Posted 6 months, 1 week ago' relative to the 2011-06-04 capture, so no exact date.
